overall.reason: Observed: all six review categories passed at 390, 320 and Safari 402 against node 14:2, and the 1440 desktop is internally consistent. The only Figma differences come from the approved Pretendard/Noto Sans KR substitution (F-01); no implementation or design defect was found in the viewed pixels. Desktop fidelity, interaction states, the footer and scroll-dependent step color have no reference and remain unknown. This approves static visual quality and mobile Figma fidelity for build a6ec654 only; it is not a readiness claim.
